keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for a state Cliopatria lacks: the republic held Gilan, 'south of the Caspian sea' in north-west Persia; the page does not say it held Mazandaran (Mazandaran appears only where Reza Khan reasserted control over 'Gilan and Mazandaran').

region.text: Gilan, in north-west Persia south of the Caspian sea

ledger.note: 1920: the Persian Socialist Soviet Republic is proclaimed at Rasht. The infobox says 'Socialist Republic declared: May 1920' and the body 'In May 1920 ... came into being' (the intro says it 'lasted from June 1920'); Mirza Kuchik Khan and his Jangali partisans founded it 'with the assistance of' the Red Army after the Soviet Caspian Fleet entered Anzali.

region.text: Gilan, in north-west Persia south of the Caspian sea

ledger.note: 1920: Gilan passes from the Qajar government to the republic of Mirza Kuchik Khan, supported by the Soviet Caspian Fleet that entered Anzali in May 1920 while the British garrison 'evacuated the town without any resistance'.

region.text: Gilan, in north-west Persia south of the Caspian sea

ledger.note: 1921: the republic is crushed. 'The Soviet Republic of Gilan officially came to an end in September 1921'; Reza Khan's coup had come several days before the Soviet-Persian treaty (February 1921) was signed and Soviet forces withdrew; Mirza fled into the Alborz and died of frostbite.

region.text: Gilan, in north-west Persia south of the Caspian sea

ledger.note: 1921: the Soviet Republic of Gilan ends in September 1921 and Gilan returns to the Persian government.

wars.name: Soviet intervention in Gilan

zones.text: Gilan, in north-west Persia south of the Caspian sea

wars.outcome: The Jangali republic held Gilan from May 1920; after the Soviet-Persian treaty of February 1921 and Reza Khan's coup it collapsed in September 1921.
wars.note: The page is silent on dated fighting between the republic and the central government.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier of the republic, only Gilan; drawn soft.

sources.title: Persian Socialist Soviet Republic
sources.note: The only page opened for this rebel state (shared with the Qajar dossier): dates, capital, territory, founders, Soviet entry and collapse.

notes: Rebel state that Cliopatria lacks, written by me-10-e because the Qajar dossier's Gilan events name it as counterpart. One page opened (page budget for a minor state): the page is internally inconsistent on the month of foundation (infobox and body May 1920, intro June 1920) and silent on the day of the Soviet-Persian treaty (infobox February 1921) and of Reza Khan's coup. The republic's territory is Gilan only on this page. Its Soviet patron is republics-of-the-soviet-union (Cliopatria 1920-1921). Wikidata id not seen (the site is unreachable), so null.
